scale_basis: Hero (full-size) scale. X = layout.json extent_m.x 28 m (Z = X*9/16 = 15.75). Checked with the drawn door step (about 1.2 m), the clearing (about 14 m across, as in the Bible) and a 3.6 m gable width. Y = chimney top 9.0 m (ridge 7.2 m per Bible).
inferred_items: house footprint 3.64 x 5.73 m: width from the drawn roof edges less the overhang; north wall base derived by removing the oblique-camera height shift (the drawn roof north edge at y 0.084 is the elevated gable top, so the base is about y 0.205)
eaves 4.8 m, ridge 7.2 m (Bible), roof as two stepped boxes
chimney 0.9 x 0.9 m at the north-west corner as drawn, top 9.0 m; its footprint is at y 0.234 while the layout.json chimney_stack landmark (0.45, 0.13) marks the projected top in the oblique image
door 1.0 x 2.1 m (Bible 2.1 m high), step 1.2 x 0.18 x 0.5 m
wood masses as crown blocks from 3 m to 10 m on 0.6 m trunks; the peep tree and plate tree as living trunks (the plate tree is drawn as a stump)
units: metres; xy = normalised plan position (x right = east, y down = south = +Z); elevation_m = centre height (host loader convention)

objects.note: solid exterior; the interior is SCN-duchess-kitchen (11 x 7 m by the Bible, bigger inside than outside by design)
ridge runs north-south; gable end faces the clearing
the only entrance; opening it and going in cuts to the kitchen

zones: the open place of trodden earth: x 0.2-0.8, y 0.1-0.85, all round the house
path leaving south-east between the east and south crowns
walkable.clearance_check: From the door step, 6+ m of open ground runs south to the tree line. The Footmen (about 1.6 m, pending_H2) and Alice have full turning room at the door. Alice's peep position is north of alice_peep_tree, with 4 m clear to plate_tree.

doorways.outside: stone step, then open clearing: over 6 m of straight run-out south
doorways.note: exterior asset only; entering cuts to SCN-duchess-kitchen

workflow_notes: The plan is slightly oblique, so the south facade shows as an elevation (a known defect from p4-env-concept-sb2). Wall bases were derived by removing the height shift. The front door and step sit at the drawn facade base (y 0.57-0.59), which matches layout.json. Logged as DEF-p4-scenemodel-973 together with the chimney landmark projection.

Two scales (Bible scale_notes): this asset is the full-size hero house. The 1:6 arrival miniature (ridge about 1.2 m) is staged by scaling the house, not as a separate asset; if a separate miniature coordinate space is needed, the director should order a split scene asset.
The Footmen's anatomy and size are pending_H2 (proposal: upright, about 1.6 m). They are actors, not scene geometry.
